source.title: IEEE Std 1609.2a-2017, Amendment 1 to IEEE Std 1609.2-2016, Annex D.6 "Cryptographic test vectors"
source.licence: IEEE copyright, no redistribution licence: values transcribed with citations, document not vendored
source.method: tools/oracle/transcribe/transcribe.py from a text extraction of the PDF; every value cross-checked against the C-array repeat printed beside it in the standard

parameters: KDF2 (IEEE 1363a section 13.2) with SHA-256 = ANSI X9.63 KDF: K = SHA-256(ss || 00000001 || kdp) || SHA-256(ss || 00000002 || kdp) || ..., truncated to dl
note: The D.6.4 output lines are not recoverable from the PDF text; out.key comes from the NIST CAVP X9.63 file entry with identical inputs (see out_cite).

vectors.cite: IEEE 1609.2a-2017 D.6.4 Test Vector #1, printed page(s) 120
